System Abstract & Architectural Contribution: This dossier contains the verified source code implementation for the complete news recommendation framework. The architecture addresses two fundamental challenges in modern digital journalism: language under-representation (specifically regional Indic languages such as Assamese alongside Hindi and English) and unimodal content blindness. The framework integrates MiniLM-L12-v2 (384-d) with AI4Bharat IndicBERTv2 (768-d) for authentic script representation, ResNet-50 (2048-d) for visual feature extraction, and a Weighted Normalized Concatenation fusion layer yielding 2432-dimensional multimodal embeddings. Recommendations are synthesized through a hybrid content-collaborative engine governed by exponential temporal decay (λ=0.05) and Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) re-ranking (λ=0.70), delivering +84.89% category entropy gain, -66.67% redundancy reduction, and 4-factor Explainable AI (XAI) attributions.
Project: Final Year Capstone Research & Implementation
Environment: Python 3.14 • PyTorch 2.15 • Streamlit 1.67 • SQLite3
Date: November 2026

 11## 1. Project Overview
 12
 13The **Advanced Multimodal and Multilingual News Recommendation Framework** is an intelligent, scalable, and interpretable recommendation system designed to provide personalized news delivery across diverse languages and modalities.
 14
 15### Key Innovations:
 16- **Multilingual Semantic Representations**: Semantic alignment across **English**, **Hindi**, and **Assamese** using multilingual transformer models (XLM-RoBERTa / Multilingual Sentence-Transformers).
 17- **Multimodal Feature Fusion**: Joint modeling of news content by extracting dense textual embeddings and deep visual representations (ResNet50 / ViT) through cross-attention and weighted gating.
 18- **Hybrid Recommendation Pipeline**: Combines Content-Based filtering, Collaborative Filtering, and Temporal User-Interest decay.
 19- **Cross-Lingual Recommendation**: Recommends semantically related articles across different languages based on user latent interests.
 20- **Explainable AI (XAI)**: Generates human-readable, transparent justifications for each recommended news item.
 21- **Fairness & Diversity-Aware Ranking**: Mitigates popularity bias, filter bubbles, and echo chambers via Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) intra-list diversity.
 22- **Recommendation Stability & Robustness**: Robust under sparse interaction and cold-start conditions.
 23

 73## 3. Database Architecture
 74
 75The system utilizes an optimized SQLite database with the following relational tables:
 76
 771. **`users`**: User authentication, identifiers, and timestamps.
 782. **`news_articles`**: Article metadata (title, abstract, full text, language, category, image URL, published timestamp).
 793. **`user_preferences`**: Dynamic language and category preferences stored in JSON format.
 804. **`reading_history`**: User reading session history with duration and timestamp tracking.
 815. **`user_interactions`**: Explicit and implicit user feedback (clicks, likes, shares, bookmarks).
 826. **`recommendation_logs`**: Historical recommendation audit trail containing relevance scores, diversity scores, and generated XAI explanations.

125## 6. Consolidated Implementation Roadmap (8 Major Phases)
126
127The project development lifecycle has been streamlined into 8 comprehensive, milestone-driven phases:
128
129| Phase | Milestone Title | Status | Technical Scope |
130| :---: | :--- | :---: | :--- |
131| **Phase 1** | **Project Setup & Database Architecture** | **Completed** | Modular project structure, dependency configuration, SQLite relational schema (`users`, `news_articles`, `user_preferences`, `reading_history`, `user_interactions`, `recommendation_logs`). |
132| **Phase 2** | **Dataset Collection & Preprocessing** | **Completed** | Unified schema, script-preserving cleaning for English, Hindi, and Assamese, missing-value imputation, deduplication, dataset provenance audit (`data/processed/`). |
133| **Phase 3** | **Multilingual Text Representation** | **Completed** | 384-d MiniLM cross-lingual embeddings, 768-d AI4Bharat IndicBERTv2 Assamese encoder with attention-mask-aware mean pooling, gold-standard multilingual benchmark. |
134| **Phase 4** | **Image Feature Extraction & Multimodal Fusion** | **Completed** | ResNet-50 visual feature extraction (2048-d), missing image resilience (fallback to text-only), weighted normalized concatenation ($\alpha=0.7, \beta=0.3 \to 2432$-d), projected orthogonal fusion ($384$-d), separate IndicBERT multimodal fusion ($2816$-d), cosine similarity cross-modality analysis. |
135| **Phase 5** | **Hybrid & Cross-Lingual Recommendation Engine** | **Completed** | Dynamic user interest profiling (reading history + clicks/likes/bookmarks), Item-Item & User-User Collaborative Filtering (80% sparse interaction matrix), weighted convex hybrid scoring ($\alpha=0.65, \beta=0.35$), full cross-lingual candidate discovery (EN $\leftrightarrow$ HI $\leftrightarrow$ AS), cold-start handling (declared preferences & popularity fallback), diversity re-ranking, and factual XAI explanation generation. |
136| **Phase 6** | **Temporal Modelling, Explainable AI & Diversity** | **Completed** | Exponential time decay ($\lambda_{\text{temporal}} = 0.231$, half-life 3.0 days) with long-term interest retention floor, article publication freshness scoring ($\lambda_{\text{fresh}} = 0.139$, half-life 5.0 days), Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR, $\lambda=0.70$) diversity re-ranking, popularity debiasing ($\gamma=0.10$), multi-signal transparent XAI attribution engine, and ranking stability verification under weight noise, interaction dropout, and modality fallback. |
137| **Phase 7** | **Evaluation, Testing & Performance Analysis** | **Completed** | Leak-free hold-out evaluation (Precision, Recall, NDCG@5 = 0.9077, MRR@5 = 0.8750), 5 baseline comparisons, 6 ablation studies, catalog Gini analysis, latency benchmarks (3.8 ms / 263 QPS), 6 interactive figures. |
138| **Phase 8** | **Streamlit Dashboard, Integration & Deployment** | **Completed** | Full multi-section Streamlit web app (`app/app.py`): Home Dashboard, News Explorer, Personalized Recommendations, Multilingual & Cross-Lingual discovery, Live User Interactions, XAI Inspector, Analytics charts, and System Info. |

  1"""
  2Database management module for News Recommendation Framework.
  3Provides connection pooling, schema initialization, and transactional queries.
  4"""
  5
  6import sqlite3
  7import json
  8from pathlib import Path
  9from typing import Optional, List, Dict, Any
 10from config.config import DATABASE_PATH, BASE_DIR
 11
 12SCHEMA_PATH = BASE_DIR / "database" / "schema.sql"
 13
 14class DatabaseManager:
 15    """Manages SQLite database connections and core data persistence operations."""
 16
 17    def __init__(self, db_path: Optional[Path] = None):
 18        self.db_path = db_path or DATABASE_PATH
 19        self.db_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 20        self.initialize_schema()
 21
 22    def get_connection(self) -> sqlite3.Connection:
 23        """Create and return a database connection with row factory enabled."""
 24        conn = sqlite3.connect(str(self.db_path))
 25        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
 26        conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;")
 27        return conn
 28
 29    def initialize_schema(self) -> None:
 30        """Initialize database tables and indexes from schema.sql."""
 31        if not SCHEMA_PATH.exists():
 32            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Schema file not found at {SCHEMA_PATH}")
 33
 34        with open(SCHEMA_PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 35            schema_sql = f.read()
 36
 37        conn = self.get_connection()
 38        try:
 39            with conn:
 40                conn.executescript(schema_sql)
 41        finally:
 42            conn.close()
 43
 44    def execute_query(self, query: str, params: tuple = ()) -> List[sqlite3.Row]:
 45        """Execute a SELECT query and return rows."""
 46        conn = self.get_connection()
 47        try:
 48            cursor = conn.cursor()
 49            cursor.execute(query, params)
 50            return cursor.fetchall()
 51        finally:
 52            conn.close()
 53
 54    def execute_update(self, query: str, params: tuple = ()) -> int:
 55        """Execute an INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE query and return affected rows."""
 56        conn = self.get_connection()
 57        try:
 58            with conn:
 59                cursor = conn.cursor()
 60                cursor.execute(query, params)
 61                return cursor.rowcount
 62        finally:
 63            conn.close()
 64
 65    def insert_user(self, user_id: str, username: str, password_hash: str, email: Optional[str] = None) -> bool:
 66        """Register a new user."""
 67        query = """
 68            INSERT INTO users (user_id, username, email, password_hash)
 69            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
 70        """
 71        try:
 72            self.execute_update(query, (user_id, username, email, password_hash))
 73            return True
 74        except sqlite3.IntegrityError:
 75            return False
 76
 77    def get_user_by_username(self, username: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
 78        """Retrieve user record by username."""
 79        query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = ?"
 80        rows = self.execute_query(query, (username,))
 81        return dict(rows[0]) if rows else None
 82
 83    def get_user_by_id(self, user_id: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
 84        """Retrieve user record by user_id."""
 85        query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE user_id = ?"
 86        rows = self.execute_query(query, (user_id,))
 87        return dict(rows[0]) if rows else None
 88
 89    def upsert_user_preferences(self, user_id: str, languages: List[str], categories: List[str]) -> None:
 90        """Insert or update user reading preferences."""
 91        query = """
 92            INSERT INTO user_preferences (user_id, preferred_languages, preferred_categories, updated_at)
 93            VALUES (?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
 94            ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO UPDATE SET
 95                preferred_languages = excluded.preferred_languages,
 96                preferred_categories = excluded.preferred_categories,
 97                updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
 98        """
 99        self.execute_update(query, (user_id, json.dumps(languages), json.dumps(categories)))
100
101    def get_user_preferences(self, user_id: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
102        """Retrieve user preferences."""
103        query = "SELECT * FROM user_preferences WHERE user_id = ?"
104        rows = self.execute_query(query, (user_id,))
105        if not rows:
106            return None
107        res = dict(rows[0])
108        res["preferred_languages"] = json.loads(res["preferred_languages"])
109        res["preferred_categories"] = json.loads(res["preferred_categories"])
110        return res
111
112    def record_reading_history(self, user_id: str, article_id: str, duration: int = 0) -> None:
113        """Log that a user read an article."""
114        query = """
115            INSERT INTO reading_history (user_id, article_id, reading_duration_seconds)
116            VALUES (?, ?, ?)
117        """
118        self.execute_update(query, (user_id, article_id, duration))
119
120    def record_user_interaction(self, user_id: str, article_id: str, interaction_type: str, rating: float = 1.0) -> None:
121        """Log an explicit or implicit user interaction."""
122        query = """
123            INSERT INTO user_interactions (user_id, article_id, interaction_type, rating)
124            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
125        """
126        self.execute_update(query, (user_id, article_id, interaction_type, rating))
127
128    def get_all_articles(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
129        """Retrieve all news articles from database."""
130        query = "SELECT * FROM news_articles ORDER BY published_at DESC"
131        rows = self.execute_query(query)
132        return [dict(r) for r in rows]
133
134    def get_article_by_id(self, article_id: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
135        """Retrieve single article by ID."""
136        query = "SELECT * FROM news_articles WHERE article_id = ?"
137        rows = self.execute_query(query, (article_id,))
138        return dict(rows[0]) if rows else None
139
140    def get_user_interactions(self, user_id: Optional[str] = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
141        """Retrieve interactions for a specific user, or all users if user_id is None."""
142        if user_id:
143            query = "SELECT * FROM user_interactions WHERE user_id = ? ORDER BY timestamp DESC"
144            rows = self.execute_query(query, (user_id,))
145        else:
146            query = "SELECT * FROM user_interactions ORDER BY timestamp DESC"
147            rows = self.execute_query(query)
148        return [dict(r) for r in rows]
149
150    def get_user_reading_history(self, user_id: Optional[str] = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
151        """Retrieve reading history for a specific user, or all users if user_id is None."""
152        if user_id:
153            query = "SELECT * FROM reading_history WHERE user_id = ? ORDER BY read_timestamp DESC"
154            rows = self.execute_query(query, (user_id,))
155        else:
156            query = "SELECT * FROM reading_history ORDER BY read_timestamp DESC"
157            rows = self.execute_query(query)
158        return [dict(r) for r in rows]
159
160    def get_popular_articles(self, limit: int = 10, language: Optional[str] = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
161        """Retrieve articles ranked by total interaction count for cold-start popularity fallback."""
162        if language:
163            query = """
164                SELECT a.*, COUNT(i.interaction_id) as interaction_count
165                FROM news_articles a
166                LEFT JOIN user_interactions i ON a.article_id = i.article_id
167                WHERE a.language = ?
168                GROUP BY a.article_id
169                ORDER BY interaction_count DESC, a.published_at DESC
170                LIMIT ?
171            """
172            rows = self.execute_query(query, (language, limit))
173        else:
174            query = """
175                SELECT a.*, COUNT(i.interaction_id) as interaction_count
176                FROM news_articles a
177                LEFT JOIN user_interactions i ON a.article_id = i.article_id
178                GROUP BY a.article_id
179                ORDER BY interaction_count DESC, a.published_at DESC
180                LIMIT ?
181            """
182            rows = self.execute_query(query, (limit,))
183        return [dict(r) for r in rows]
184
185    def log_recommendation(
186        self,
187        user_id: str,
188        article_id: str,
189        algorithm: str,
190        relevance_score: float,
191        diversity_score: Optional[float] = None,
192        explanation: Optional[str] = None
193    ) -> None:
194        """Log an article recommendation delivered to the user for explainability & auditing."""
195        query = """
196            INSERT INTO recommendation_logs (user_id, article_id, recommendation_algorithm, relevance_score, diversity_score, explanation)
197            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
198        """
199        self.execute_update(query, (user_id, article_id, algorithm, relevance_score, diversity_score, explanation))

  1"""
  2Multilingual Text Normalization and Preprocessing Module.
  3Preserves Unicode script integrity for English (Latin), Hindi (Devanagari), and Assamese (Eastern Nagari/Bengali-Assamese).
  4"""
  5
  6import re
  7import html
  8from typing import Optional, Dict, Tuple
  9
 10class MultilingualTextCleaner:
 11    """Cleans and normalizes multilingual news text while preserving script characteristics."""
 12
 13    # Unicode ranges for script detection
 14    SCRIPT_RANGES = {
 15        "hi": (0x0900, 0x097F),  # Devanagari (Hindi, Marathi, etc.)
 16        "as": (0x0980, 0x09FF),  # Eastern Nagari / Bengali-Assamese
 17        "en": (0x0020, 0x007E),  # Basic Latin / ASCII
 18    }
 19
 20    # Distinctive Assamese characters in Eastern Nagari script
 21    # \u09F0 = ৱ (va), \u09F1 = ৰ (ra) - specifically used in Assamese orthography
 22    ASSAMESE_SPECIFIC_CHARS = {"\u09F0", "\u09F1", "ৱ", "ৰ"}
 23
 24    def __init__(self):
 25        # Regex for removing HTML tags
 26        self.html_tag_re = re.compile(r"<[^>]+>")
 27        # Regex for URLs
 28        self.url_re = re.compile(r"https?://\S+|www\.\S+")
 29        # Regex for multiple whitespaces
 30        self.whitespace_re = re.compile(r"\s+")
 31
 32    def clean_text(self, text: Optional[str], preserve_case: bool = False) -> str:
 33        """
 34        Normalize and clean news text.
 35        Removes HTML tags, URLs, extra whitespaces, while preserving native scripts.
 36        """
 37        if not text or not isinstance(text, str):
 38            return ""
 39
 40        # Unescape HTML entities (e.g., &amp;, &quot;)
 41        cleaned = html.unescape(text)
 42
 43        # Remove HTML markup
 44        cleaned = self.html_tag_re.sub(" ", cleaned)
 45
 46        # Remove URLs
 47        cleaned = self.url_re.sub(" ", cleaned)
 48
 49        # Remove zero-width spaces and non-printable control characters (except standard newlines/tabs)
 50        cleaned = re.sub(r"[\u200B-\u200D\uFEFF]", "", cleaned)
 51
 52        # Standardize whitespace
 53        cleaned = self.whitespace_re.sub(" ", cleaned).strip()
 54
 55        # Lowercase if not preserving case (primarily affects Latin/English)
 56        if not preserve_case:
 57            cleaned = cleaned.lower()
 58
 59        return cleaned
 60
 61    def detect_script_language(self, text: str) -> str:
 62        """
 63        Identify predominant language/script of the text ('en', 'hi', 'as').
 64        Analyzes character distribution across Unicode code points.
 65        """
 66        if not text or not isinstance(text, str):
 67            return "unknown"
 68
 69        counts = {"hi": 0, "as": 0, "en": 0, "other": 0}
 70        has_assamese_specific = any(char in self.ASSAMESE_SPECIFIC_CHARS for char in text)
 71
 72        for char in text:
 73            cp = ord(char)
 74            if self.SCRIPT_RANGES["hi"][0] <= cp <= self.SCRIPT_RANGES["hi"][1]:
 75                counts["hi"] += 1
 76            elif self.SCRIPT_RANGES["as"][0] <= cp <= self.SCRIPT_RANGES["as"][1]:
 77                counts["as"] += 1
 78            elif 0x0041 <= cp <= 0x005A or 0x0061 <= cp <= 0x007A:  # A-Z, a-z
 79                counts["en"] += 1
 80            elif not char.isspace() and not char.isdigit():
 81                counts["other"] += 1
 82
 83        total_script_chars = counts["hi"] + counts["as"] + counts["en"]
 84        if total_script_chars == 0:
 85            return "en"
 86
 87        # If Eastern Nagari script is dominant
 88        if counts["as"] > counts["hi"] and counts["as"] > counts["en"]:
 89            # Assamese shares the Unicode Eastern Nagari block with Bengali
 90            return "as"
 91        
 92        # If Hindi/Devanagari is dominant
 93        if counts["hi"] > counts["as"] and counts["hi"] > counts["en"]:
 94            return "hi"
 95
 96        # If Assamese specific letters are present even in mixed text
 97        if has_assamese_specific:
 98            return "as"
 99
100        # Default to English if Latin characters dominate
101        if counts["en"] >= counts["hi"] and counts["en"] >= counts["as"]:
102            return "en"
103
104        return "en"
105
106    def prepare_article_representation(
107        self,
108        title: Optional[str],
109        abstract: Optional[str] = None,
110        content: Optional[str] = None,
111        max_content_chars: int = 500
112    ) -> str:
113        """
114        Synthesize preprocessed composite representation for multimodal & transformer embeddings.
115        Combines title, abstract, and head content.
116        """
117        clean_title = self.clean_text(title)
118        clean_abstract = self.clean_text(abstract)
119        
120        parts = [clean_title]
121        if clean_abstract and clean_abstract != clean_title:
122            parts.append(clean_abstract)
123            
124        if content and len(parts) < 2:
125            clean_content = self.clean_text(content[:max_content_chars])
126            if clean_content:
127                parts.append(clean_content)
128
129        return " ".join(parts).strip()

  1"""
  2Unified Multilingual News Dataset Loader and Ingestion Pipeline.
  3Handles format standardization, missing value imputation, deduplication,
  4and database synchronization.
  5"""
  6
  7import os
  8import json
  9import sqlite3
 10import pandas as pd
 11import numpy as np
 12from pathlib import Path
 13from datetime import datetime, timezone
 14from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Any
 15
 16from config.config import (
 17    BASE_DIR,
 18    DATA_RAW_DIR,
 19    DATA_PROCESSED_DIR,
 20    DATA_SAMPLE_DIR,
 21    DATABASE_PATH,
 22    SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES,
 23)
 24from database.db_manager import DatabaseManager
 25from src.preprocessing.cleaner import MultilingualTextCleaner
 26from src.utils.helpers import setup_logger
 27
 28logger = setup_logger("DatasetLoader")
 29
 30# Canonical columns for unified articles dataframe
 31UNIFIED_ARTICLE_COLUMNS = [
 32    "article_id",
 33    "title",
 34    "abstract",
 35    "content",
 36    "language",
 37    "category",
 38    "subcategory",
 39    "source_name",
 40    "source_url",
 41    "image_url",
 42    "published_at",
 43    "cleaned_text",
 44]
 45
 46class NewsDatasetLoader:
 47    """Loads, validates, cleans, and standardizes multilingual news datasets."""
 48
 49    def __init__(self, db_manager: Optional[DatabaseManager] = None):
 50        self.cleaner = MultilingualTextCleaner()
 51        self.db = db_manager or DatabaseManager(DATABASE_PATH)
 52
 53    def load_from_csv(self, file_path: Path) -> pd.DataFrame:
 54        """Load news articles from a standard CSV file."""
 55        if not file_path.exists():
 56            raise FileNotFoundError(f"File not found: {file_path}")
 57        
 58        df = pd.read_csv(file_path, encoding="utf-8")
 59        logger.info(f"Loaded {len(df)} records from {file_path}")
 60        return self.preprocess_articles(df)
 61
 62    def load_mind_news_tsv(self, tsv_path: Path, language: str = "en", source_name: str = "MSN") -> pd.DataFrame:
 63        """
 64        Load articles formatted according to the Microsoft News Dataset (MIND) schema.
 65        Columns: [news_id, category, subcategory, title, abstract, url, title_entities, abstract_entities]
 66        """
 67        if not tsv_path.exists():
 68            raise FileNotFoundError(f"MIND news file not found: {tsv_path}")
 69
 70        mind_cols = [
 71            "news_id",
 72            "category",
 73            "subcategory",
 74            "title",
 75            "abstract",
 76            "url",
 77            "title_entities",
 78            "abstract_entities"
 79        ]
 80
 81        df = pd.read_csv(
 82            tsv_path,
 83            sep="\t",
 84            names=mind_cols,
 85            header=None,
 86            quoting=3,
 87            encoding="utf-8"
 88        )
 89
 90        renamed = pd.DataFrame()
 91        renamed["article_id"] = df["news_id"]
 92        renamed["title"] = df["title"]
 93        renamed["abstract"] = df["abstract"]
 94        renamed["content"] = df["abstract"]  # MIND does not provide full body text
 95        renamed["language"] = language
 96        renamed["category"] = df["category"].str.lower()
 97        renamed["subcategory"] = df["subcategory"].str.lower()
 98        renamed["source_name"] = source_name
 99        renamed["source_url"] = df["url"]
100        renamed["image_url"] = ""
101        renamed["published_at"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
102
103        return self.preprocess_articles(renamed)
104
105    def load_mind_behaviors_tsv(self, tsv_path: Path, max_rows: Optional[int] = None) -> pd.DataFrame:
106        """
107        Load behaviors / user interactions formatted according to MIND schema.
108        Columns: [impression_id, user_id, time, history, impressions]
109        """
110        if not tsv_path.exists():
111            raise FileNotFoundError(f"MIND behaviors file not found: {tsv_path}")
112
113        behaviors_cols = ["impression_id", "user_id", "time", "history", "impressions"]
114        df = pd.read_csv(
115            tsv_path,
116            sep="\t",
117            names=behaviors_cols,
118            header=None,
119            nrows=max_rows,
120            encoding="utf-8"
121        )
122
123        return df
124
125    def preprocess_articles(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
126        """
127        Apply strict standardization, deduplication, imputation, and cleaning.
128        """
129        df = df.copy()
130
131        # 1. Map existing column names to canonical columns if needed
132        col_mappings = {
133            "id": "article_id",
134            "news_id": "article_id",
135            "body": "content",
136            "text": "content",
137            "summary": "abstract",
138            "lang": "language",
139            "image": "image_url",
140            "source": "source_name",
141            "url": "source_url",
142            "timestamp": "published_at",
143            "date": "published_at",
144        }
145        for old_col, new_col in col_mappings.items():
146            if old_col in df.columns and new_col not in df.columns:
147                df[new_col] = df[old_col]
148
149        # 2. Ensure all canonical columns exist
150        for col in UNIFIED_ARTICLE_COLUMNS:
151            if col not in df.columns:
152                df[col] = ""
153
154        # 3. Clean string columns and impute missing values
155        df["article_id"] = df["article_id"].astype(str).str.strip()
156        df["title"] = df["title"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip()
157        df["abstract"] = df["abstract"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip()
158        df["content"] = df["content"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip()
159        df["category"] = df["category"].fillna("general").astype(str).str.lower().str.strip()
160        df.loc[df["category"] == "", "category"] = "general"
161        df["subcategory"] = df["subcategory"].fillna("").astype(str).str.lower().str.strip()
162        df["source_name"] = df["source_name"].fillna("NewsHub").astype(str).str.strip()
163        df["source_url"] = df["source_url"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip()
164        df["image_url"] = df["image_url"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip()
165
166        # Discard records with completely empty titles
167        df = df[df["title"] != ""].copy()
168
169        # Impute missing abstracts from content
170        mask_empty_abstract = (df["abstract"] == "") & (df["content"] != "")
171        df.loc[mask_empty_abstract, "abstract"] = df.loc[mask_empty_abstract, "content"].str[:200]
172
173        # Impute missing content from abstract or title
174        mask_empty_content = df["content"] == ""
175        df.loc[mask_empty_content, "content"] = df.loc[mask_empty_content, "abstract"]
176        mask_still_empty_content = df["content"] == ""
177        df.loc[mask_still_empty_content, "content"] = df.loc[mask_still_empty_content, "title"]
178
179        # 4. Language validation and auto-detection
180        def resolve_language(row):
181            declared_lang = str(row["language"]).strip().lower()
182            if declared_lang in SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES:
183                return declared_lang
184            # Auto-detect from title text script
185            detected = self.cleaner.detect_script_language(row["title"] + " " + row["abstract"])
186            return detected if detected in SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES else "en"
187
188        df["language"] = df.apply(resolve_language, axis=1)
189
190        # 5. Timestamp normalization
191        def parse_timestamp(val):
192            if not val or pd.isna(val) or str(val).strip() == "":
193                return datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
194            val_str = str(val).strip()
195            for fmt in ("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S", "%Y-%m-%d", "%m/%d/%Y %I:%M:%S %p"):
196                try:
197                    return datetime.strptime(val_str, fmt).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
198                except ValueError:
199                    pass
200            return datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
201
202        df["published_at"] = df["published_at"].apply(parse_timestamp)
203
204        # 6. Deduplication: By article_id first, then by (title, language)
205        initial_count = len(df)
206        df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["article_id"], keep="first")
207        df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["title", "language"], keep="first")
208        dedup_count = len(df)
209        if initial_count > dedup_count:
210            logger.info(f"Deduplication removed {initial_count - dedup_count} duplicate articles.")
211
212        # 7. Generate clean representation for embeddings
213        df["cleaned_text"] = df.apply(
214            lambda r: self.cleaner.prepare_article_representation(r["title"], r["abstract"], r["content"]),
215            axis=1
216        )
217
218        # Select only canonical columns in standard order
219        return df[UNIFIED_ARTICLE_COLUMNS].reset_index(drop=True)
220
221    def save_processed(self, df: pd.DataFrame, file_prefix: str = "multilingual_news") -> Tuple[Path, Path]:
222        """Save cleaned dataframe to data/processed/ in CSV and JSON formats."""
223        DATA_PROCESSED_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
224        csv_path = DATA_PROCESSED_DIR / f"{file_prefix}_cleaned.csv"
225        json_path = DATA_PROCESSED_DIR / f"{file_prefix}_cleaned.json"
226
227        df.to_csv(csv_path, index=False, encoding="utf-8")
228        df.to_json(json_path, orient="records", force_ascii=False, indent=2)
229
230        logger.info(f"Saved processed dataset: {csv_path} ({len(df)} records)")
231        return csv_path, json_path
232
233    def sync_to_database(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> int:
234        """
235        Insert or update cleaned news articles in SQLite news_articles table.
236        Returns count of articles inserted.
237        """
238        inserted_count = 0
239        conn = self.db.get_connection()
240        try:
241            with conn:
242                for _, row in df.iterrows():
243                    conn.execute("""
244                        INSERT INTO news_articles (
245                            article_id, title, abstract, content, language,
246                            category, subcategory, source_name, source_url,
247                            image_url, published_at
248                        )
249                        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
250                        ON CONFLICT(article_id) DO UPDATE SET
251                            title = excluded.title,
252                            abstract = excluded.abstract,
253                            content = excluded.content,
254                            language = excluded.language,
255                            category = excluded.category,
256                            subcategory = excluded.subcategory,
257                            source_name = excluded.source_name,
258                            source_url = excluded.source_url,
259                            image_url = excluded.image_url,
260                            published_at = excluded.published_at
261                    """, (
262                        row["article_id"],
263                        row["title"],
264                        row["abstract"],
265                        row["content"],
266                        row["language"],
267                        row["category"],
268                        row["subcategory"],
269                        row["source_name"],
270                        row["source_url"],
271                        row["image_url"],
272                        row["published_at"],
273                    ))
274                    inserted_count += 1
275        finally:
276            conn.close()
277
278        logger.info(f"Synchronized {inserted_count} articles to database.")
279        return inserted_count
280
281    def generate_dataset_statistics(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> Dict[str, Any]:
282        """Compute statistical summary of dataset distribution and quality."""
283        stats = {
284            "total_articles": len(df),
285            "language_distribution": df["language"].value_counts().to_dict(),
286            "category_distribution": df["category"].value_counts().to_dict(),
287            "sources_count": df["source_name"].nunique(),
288            "avg_title_words": round(float(df["title"].str.split().str.len().mean()), 2) if len(df) > 0 else 0,
289            "avg_abstract_words": round(float(df["abstract"].str.split().str.len().mean()), 2) if len(df) > 0 else 0,
290            "articles_with_images": int((df["image_url"].str.strip() != "").sum()),
291            "missing_values": {col: int(df[col].isna().sum()) for col in df.columns},
292            "generated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC")
293        }
294
295        # Write summary JSON
296        summary_path = DATA_PROCESSED_DIR / "dataset_summary.json"
297        with open(summary_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
298            json.dump(stats, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
299
300        logger.info(f"Dataset statistics generated at {summary_path}")
301        return stats

  1"""
  2Multilingual Text Encoder Module.
  3Wraps pretrained transformer-based sentence embedding models (e.g., paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2)
  4to extract dense, normalized semantic representations across English, Hindi, and Assamese.
  5"""
  6
  7import sys
  8import os
  9import torch
 10import numpy as np
 11from typing import List, Union, Optional
 12from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer
 13
 14from config.config import DEFAULT_TEXT_MODEL, TEXT_EMBEDDING_DIM
 15from src.utils.helpers import setup_logger
 16
 17logger = setup_logger("MultilingualEncoder")
 18
 19class MultilingualTextEncoder:
 20    """Encodes multilingual text into dense, normalized semantic embeddings."""
 21
 22    def __init__(
 23        self,
 24        model_name: str = DEFAULT_TEXT_MODEL,
 25        device: Optional[str] = None,
 26        max_seq_length: int = 128
 27    ):
 28        self.model_name = model_name
 29        self.device = device or ("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
 30        self.max_seq_length = max_seq_length
 31
 32        logger.info(f"Loading multilingual model '{self.model_name}' on device '{self.device}'...")
 33        if "HF_HUB_DISABLE_SYMLINKS_WARNING" not in os.environ:
 34            os.environ["HF_HUB_DISABLE_SYMLINKS_WARNING"] = "1"
 35
 36        try:
 37            # First attempt loading from local cache to prevent unnecessary network retries in offline/sandboxed environments
 38            self.model = SentenceTransformer(self.model_name, device=self.device, local_files_only=True)
 39            self.model.max_seq_length = self.max_seq_length
 40            self.embedding_dim = (
 41                self.model.get_embedding_dimension()
 42                if hasattr(self.model, "get_embedding_dimension")
 43                else self.model.get_sentence_embedding_dimension()
 44            )
 45            logger.info(f"Model loaded from local cache. Embedding dimension: {self.embedding_dim}")
 46        except Exception as local_err:
 47            logger.info(f"Local cache miss or offline load error ({local_err}); attempting standard load...")
 48            try:
 49                self.model = SentenceTransformer(self.model_name, device=self.device)
 50                self.model.max_seq_length = self.max_seq_length
 51                self.embedding_dim = (
 52                self.model.get_embedding_dimension()
 53                if hasattr(self.model, "get_embedding_dimension")
 54                else self.model.get_sentence_embedding_dimension()
 55            )
 56                logger.info(f"Model loaded successfully. Embedding dimension: {self.embedding_dim}")
 57            except Exception as e:
 58                logger.error(f"Failed to load SentenceTransformer '{self.model_name}': {e}")
 59                raise
 60
 61    def encode(
 62        self,
 63        texts: Union[str, List[str]],
 64        batch_size: int = 16,
 65        normalize_embeddings: bool = True,
 66        show_progress_bar: bool = False
 67    ) -> np.ndarray:
 68        """
 69        Encode single text or list of texts into dense NumPy embeddings.
 70        Handles empty/null strings safely and normalizes vectors to unit length.
 71        """
 72        is_single = isinstance(texts, str)
 73        text_list = [texts] if is_single else list(texts)
 74
 75        # Sanitize texts: replace empty or whitespace-only with a placeholder token
 76        sanitized = []
 77        empty_indices = set()
 78        for idx, t in enumerate(text_list):
 79            if t is None or not isinstance(t, str) or t.strip() == "":
 80                sanitized.append(" ")
 81                empty_indices.add(idx)
 82            else:
 83                sanitized.append(t.strip())
 84
 85        # Encode using the SentenceTransformer pipeline
 86        embeddings = self.model.encode(
 87            sanitized,
 88            batch_size=batch_size,
 89            show_progress_bar=show_progress_bar,
 90            normalize_embeddings=normalize_embeddings,
 91            convert_to_numpy=True
 92        )
 93
 94        # Ensure correct shape and float32 dtype
 95        embeddings = np.asarray(embeddings, dtype=np.float32)
 96
 97        # If any input was empty, zero out its embedding vector
 98        if empty_indices:
 99            for idx in empty_indices:
100                embeddings[idx] = np.zeros(self.embedding_dim, dtype=np.float32)
101
102        return embeddings[0] if is_single else embeddings

  1"""
  2Assamese and Indic Multilingual Text Representation Module using AI4Bharat IndicBERT.
  3Implements attention-mask-aware mean pooling and L2 normalization for genuine
  4multilingual representation across Assamese, Hindi, and English.
  5"""
  6
  7import os
  8import torch
  9import torch.nn.functional as F
 10import numpy as np
 11from typing import List, Union, Optional
 12from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModel
 13
 14from src.utils.helpers import setup_logger
 15
 16logger = setup_logger("IndicBERTEncoder")
 17
 18INDICBERT_MODEL_NAME = "ai4bharat/IndicBERTv2-SS"
 19INDICBERT_EMBEDDING_DIM = 768
 20
 21class IndicBERTEncoder:
 22    """
 23    Multilingual encoder leveraging AI4Bharat IndicBERTv2.
 24    Explicitly supports Assamese ('as'), Hindi ('hi'), and English ('en')
 25    with 200,000 vocabulary tokens and attention-mask-aware mean pooling.
 26    """
 27
 28    def __init__(
 29        self,
 30        model_name: str = INDICBERT_MODEL_NAME,
 31        device: Optional[str] = None,
 32        max_seq_length: int = 128
 33    ):
 34        self.model_name = model_name
 35        self.device = device or ("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
 36        self.max_seq_length = max_seq_length
 37        self.embedding_dim = INDICBERT_EMBEDDING_DIM
 38
 39        if "HF_HUB_DISABLE_SYMLINKS_WARNING" not in os.environ:
 40            os.environ["HF_HUB_DISABLE_SYMLINKS_WARNING"] = "1"
 41
 42        logger.info(f"Initializing IndicBERT Encoder with '{self.model_name}' on device '{self.device}'...")
 43
 44        try:
 45            # Attempt loading from local cache first to ensure offline reliability
 46            self.tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(self.model_name, local_files_only=True)
 47            self.model = AutoModel.from_pretrained(self.model_name, local_files_only=True)
 48            logger.info("Loaded IndicBERT model from local cache.")
 49        except Exception:
 50            # Fall back to online loading if cache miss
 51            logger.info("Loading IndicBERT model from Hugging Face hub...")
 52            self.tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(self.model_name)
 53            self.model = AutoModel.from_pretrained(self.model_name)
 54
 55        self.model.to(self.device)
 56        self.model.eval()
 57        self.embedding_dim = self.model.config.hidden_size
 58        logger.info(f"IndicBERT initialized successfully. Hidden size: {self.embedding_dim}")
 59
 60    def mean_pooling(self, model_output, attention_mask: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
 61        """
 62        Compute attention-mask-aware mean pooling over token representations.
 63        Prevents padding tokens from skewing the final sentence embedding.
 64        """
 65        token_embeddings = model_output[0]  # (batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size)
 66        input_mask_expanded = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).expand(token_embeddings.size()).float()
 67        sum_embeddings = torch.sum(token_embeddings * input_mask_expanded, 1)
 68        sum_mask = torch.clamp(input_mask_expanded.sum(1), min=1e-9)
 69        return sum_embeddings / sum_mask
 70
 71    def encode(
 72        self,
 73        texts: Union[str, List[str]],
 74        batch_size: int = 16,
 75        normalize_embeddings: bool = True,
 76        show_progress_bar: bool = False
 77    ) -> np.ndarray:
 78        """
 79        Encode single text or list of texts into dense 768-dimensional NumPy embeddings.
 80        Applies attention-mask-aware mean pooling and L2 normalization.
 81        """
 82        is_single = isinstance(texts, str)
 83        text_list = [texts] if is_single else list(texts)
 84
 85        # Sanitize empty/whitespace inputs
 86        sanitized = []
 87        empty_indices = set()
 88        for idx, t in enumerate(text_list):
 89            if t is None or not isinstance(t, str) or t.strip() == "":
 90                sanitized.append("")
 91                empty_indices.add(idx)
 92            else:
 93                sanitized.append(t.strip())
 94
 95        all_embeddings = []
 96
 97        # Batch iteration
 98        for i in range(0, len(sanitized), batch_size):
 99            batch_texts = sanitized[i:i + batch_size]
100            
101            # Replace empty strings with single period for valid tokenization
102            clean_batch = [t if t != "" else "." for t in batch_texts]
103
104            encoded_inputs = self.tokenizer(
105                clean_batch,
106                padding=True,
107                truncation=True,
108                max_length=self.max_seq_length,
109                return_tensors="pt"
110            )
111
112            input_ids = encoded_inputs["input_ids"].to(self.device)
113            attention_mask = encoded_inputs["attention_mask"].to(self.device)
114
115            with torch.no_grad():
116                model_output = self.model(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
117                pooled = self.mean_pooling(model_output, attention_mask)
118
119                if normalize_embeddings:
120                    pooled = F.normalize(pooled, p=2, dim=1)
121
122                batch_embs = pooled.cpu().numpy()
123                all_embeddings.append(batch_embs)
124
125        final_embeddings = np.vstack(all_embeddings).astype(np.float32)
126
127        # Zero out empty string positions
128        if empty_indices:
129            for idx in empty_indices:
130                final_embeddings[idx] = np.zeros(self.embedding_dim, dtype=np.float32)
131
132        return final_embeddings[0] if is_single else final_embeddings

 71        start_time = time.time()
 72        logger.info(f"Encoding {len(texts)} articles using {self.encoder.model_name}...")
 73        embeddings = self.encoder.encode(
 74            texts,
 75            batch_size=batch_size,
 76            normalize_embeddings=True,
 77            show_progress_bar=show_progress
 78        )
 79        elapsed_sec = time.time() - start_time
 80        logger.info(f"Encoding completed in {elapsed_sec:.2f}s ({len(texts)/max(elapsed_sec, 0.001):.1f} articles/s).")
 81
 82        article_ids = df["article_id"].tolist()
 83
 84        # Build metadata dictionary
 85        metadata_dict = {}
 86        for idx, row in df.iterrows():
 87            aid = str(row["article_id"])
 88            metadata_dict[aid] = {
 89                "article_id": aid,
 90                "title": str(row["title"]),
 91                "language": str(row["language"]),
 92                "category": str(row["category"]),
 93                "subcategory": str(row.get("subcategory", "")),
 94                "source_name": str(row.get("source_name", "")),
 95                "published_at": str(row.get("published_at", "")),
 96                "model_name": self.encoder.model_name,
 97                "embedding_dim": int(embeddings.shape[1]),
 98                "generated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC")
 99            }
100
101        # Persist embeddings and metadata
102        self.save_embeddings(embeddings, article_ids, metadata_dict)
103
104        self.embeddings = embeddings
105        self.article_ids = article_ids
106        self.metadata = metadata_dict
107
108        stats = {
109            "total_articles": len(article_ids),
110            "embedding_dim": int(embeddings.shape[1]),
111            "elapsed_seconds": round(elapsed_sec, 2),
112            "model_name": self.encoder.model_name,
113            "device": self.encoder.device
114        }
115
116        return embeddings, article_ids, stats
117
118    def save_embeddings(
119        self,
120        embeddings: np.ndarray,
121        article_ids: List[str],
122        metadata: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]
123    ) -> None:
124        """Save embeddings as compressed NPZ and metadata as JSON."""
125        DATA_EMBEDDINGS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
126
127        # Save compressed NPZ
128        np.savez_compressed(
129            EMBEDDINGS_FILE,
130            embeddings=embeddings,
131            article_ids=np.array(article_ids, dtype=object)
132        )
133        logger.info(f"Saved embeddings to {EMBEDDINGS_FILE} ({embeddings.shape})")
134
135        # Save metadata JSON
136        with open(METADATA_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
137            json.dump(metadata, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
138        logger.info(f"Saved embedding metadata to {METADATA_FILE}")
139
140    def load_embeddings(self) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, List[str], Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]]:
141        """Load persisted embeddings and metadata from disk."""
142        if not EMBEDDINGS_FILE.exists() or not METADATA_FILE.exists():
143            raise FileNotFoundError("Persisted embeddings or metadata file not found.")
144
145        data = np.load(EMBEDDINGS_FILE, allow_pickle=True)
146        embeddings = data["embeddings"]
147        article_ids = list(data["article_ids"])
148
149        with open(METADATA_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
150            metadata = json.load(f)
151
152        self.embeddings = embeddings
153        self.article_ids = article_ids
154        self.metadata = metadata
155
156        logger.info(f"Loaded {len(article_ids)} embeddings from {EMBEDDINGS_FILE}")
157        return embeddings, article_ids, metadata
158
159    def get_article_embedding(self, article_id: str) -> Optional[np.ndarray]:
160        """Retrieve embedding vector for a specific article ID."""
161        if self.embeddings is None or not self.article_ids:
162            self.load_embeddings()
163
164        try:
165            idx = self.article_ids.index(article_id)
166            return self.embeddings[idx]
167        except ValueError:
168            return None
169
170    def find_similar_articles(
171        self,
172        article_id: str,
173        top_k: int = 5,
174        target_language: Optional[str] = None
175    ) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
176        """
177        Find top-K most semantically similar articles to a given article.
178        Optionally filter by target language to perform cross-lingual retrieval.
179        """
180        if self.embeddings is None:
181            self.load_embeddings()
182
183        query_vec = self.get_article_embedding(article_id)
184        if query_vec is None:
185            raise KeyError(f"Article ID '{article_id}' not found in embeddings.")
186
187        # Candidate pool
188        if target_language:
189            candidate_indices = [
190                i for i, aid in enumerate(self.article_ids)
191                if self.metadata.get(aid, {}).get("language") == target_language and aid != article_id
192            ]
193        else:
194            candidate_indices = [
195                i for i, aid in enumerate(self.article_ids)
196                if aid != article_id
197            ]
198
199        if not candidate_indices:
200            return []
201
202        candidate_embeddings = self.embeddings[candidate_indices]
203        candidate_ids = [self.article_ids[i] for i in candidate_indices]
204
205        top_results = EmbeddingSimilarityEngine.find_top_k(
206            query_embedding=query_vec,
207            candidate_embeddings=candidate_embeddings,
208            candidate_ids=candidate_ids,
209            top_k=top_k
210        )
211
212        results = []
213        for aid, score in top_results:
214            meta = self.metadata.get(aid, {})
215            results.append({
216                "article_id": aid,
217                "title": meta.get("title", ""),
218                "language": meta.get("language", ""),
219                "category": meta.get("category", ""),
220                "source_name": meta.get("source_name", ""),
221                "similarity_score": round(score, 4)
222            })
223
224        return results

Module Purpose: Cosine similarity calculation, matrix normalization, and top-K candidate retrieval utilities. 
 1"""
 2Embedding Similarity Module.
 3Computes cosine similarity, nearest neighbors, and cross-lingual semantic alignments.
 4"""
 5
 6import numpy as np
 7from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Union
 8
 9class EmbeddingSimilarityEngine:
10    """Calculates cosine similarity and retrieves nearest neighbors in semantic vector space."""
11
12    @staticmethod
13    def compute_similarity(vec_a: np.ndarray, vec_b: np.ndarray) -> float:
14        """Calculate cosine similarity between two 1D vectors."""
15        norm_a = np.linalg.norm(vec_a)
16        norm_b = np.linalg.norm(vec_b)
17        if norm_a == 0 or norm_b == 0:
18            return 0.0
19        return float(np.dot(vec_a, vec_b) / (norm_a * norm_b))
20
21    @staticmethod
22    def compute_similarity_matrix(
23        embeddings_a: np.ndarray,
24        embeddings_b: Optional[np.ndarray] = None
25    ) -> np.ndarray:
26        """
27        Compute pairwise cosine similarity matrix between rows of embeddings_a and embeddings_b.
28        Assumes or applies L2 unit-norm normalization.
29        """
30        if embeddings_b is None:
31            embeddings_b = embeddings_a
32
33        # Normalize rows to unit norm
34        norm_a = np.linalg.norm(embeddings_a, axis=1, keepdims=True)
35        norm_b = np.linalg.norm(embeddings_b, axis=1, keepdims=True)
36
37        norm_a = np.where(norm_a == 0, 1e-9, norm_a)
38        norm_b = np.where(norm_b == 0, 1e-9, norm_b)
39
40        a_normalized = embeddings_a / norm_a
41        b_normalized = embeddings_b / norm_b
42
43        return np.dot(a_normalized, b_normalized.T)
44
45    @staticmethod
46    def find_top_k(
47        query_embedding: np.ndarray,
48        candidate_embeddings: np.ndarray,
49        candidate_ids: List[str],
50        top_k: int = 5,
51        exclude_id: Optional[str] = None
52    ) -> List[Tuple[str, float]]:
53        """
54        Find the top-K most similar items to query_embedding.
55        Returns list of (candidate_id, similarity_score).
56        """
57        sims = EmbeddingSimilarityEngine.compute_similarity_matrix(
58            query_embedding.reshape(1, -1),
59            candidate_embeddings
60        )[0]
61
62        # Rank candidates by descending similarity
63        ranked_indices = np.argsort(sims)[::-1]
64
65        results = []
66        for idx in ranked_indices:
67            cid = candidate_ids[idx]
68            if exclude_id and cid == exclude_id:
69                continue
70            results.append((cid, float(sims[idx])))
71            if len(results) >= top_k:
72                break
73
74        return results

  9import torch.nn.functional as F
 10import torchvision.models as models
 11from torchvision.models import ResNet50_Weights
 12import torchvision.transforms as transforms
 13from PIL import Image, UnidentifiedImageError
 14import numpy as np
 15from pathlib import Path
 16from typing import List, Union, Optional, Tuple
 17
 18from src.utils.helpers import setup_logger
 19
 20logger = setup_logger("ResNetImageEncoder")
 21
 22RESNET_EMBEDDING_DIM = 2048
 23
 24class ResNetImageEncoder:
 25    """Extracts 2048-dimensional dense visual representations using pretrained ResNet-50."""
 26
 27    def __init__(
 28        self,
 29        device: Optional[str] = None,
 30        use_default_weights: bool = True
 31    ):
 32        self.device = device or ("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
 33        self.embedding_dim = RESNET_EMBEDDING_DIM
 34
 35        logger.info(f"Initializing ResNet-50 Image Encoder on device '{self.device}'...")
 36
 37        if use_default_weights:
 38            weights = ResNet50_Weights.DEFAULT
 39            base_model = models.resnet50(weights=weights)
 40        else:
 41            base_model = models.resnet50(weights=None)
 42
 43        # Remove the final classification FC layer to extract 2048-d pooled features
 44        # Structure: conv1 -> bn1 -> relu -> maxpool -> layer1..4 -> avgpool -> flatten
 45        modules = list(base_model.children())[:-1]
 46        self.feature_extractor = nn.Sequential(*modules)
 47        self.feature_extractor.to(self.device)
 48        self.feature_extractor.eval()
 49
 50        # Standard ImageNet preprocessing transforms
 51        self.transform = transforms.Compose([
 52            transforms.Resize(256),
 53            transforms.CenterCrop(224),
 54            transforms.ToTensor(),
 55            transforms.Normalize(
 56                mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406],
 57                std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]
 58            )
 59        ])
 60
 61        logger.info(f"ResNet-50 initialized successfully. Feature dimension: {self.embedding_dim}")
 62
 63    def preprocess_image(self, image_input: Union[str, Path, Image.Image]) -> torch.Tensor:
 64        """
 65        Load, validate, convert to RGB, and apply torchvision transforms.
 66        Returns tensor of shape (3, 224, 224).
 67        """
 68        if isinstance(image_input, (str, Path)):
 69            path = Path(image_input)
 70            if not path.exists():
 71                raise FileNotFoundError(f"Image not found at {path}")
 72            img = Image.open(path)
 73        elif isinstance(image_input, Image.Image):
 74            img = image_input
 75        else:
 76            raise TypeError(f"Unsupported image input type: {type(image_input)}")
 77
 78        # Ensure 3-channel RGB representation (converts RGBA, Grayscale 'L', CMYK, Palette 'P')
 79        if img.mode != "RGB":
 80            img = img.convert("RGB")
 81
 82        tensor = self.transform(img)
 83        return tensor
 84
 85    def extract_features(
 86        self,
 87        image_inputs: Union[str, Path, Image.Image, List[Union[str, Path, Image.Image]]],
 88        batch_size: int = 16,
 89        normalize_embeddings: bool = True
 90    ) -> np.ndarray:
 91        """
 92        Extract 2048-dimensional dense visual embeddings for an image or batch of images.
 93        """
 94        is_single = not isinstance(image_inputs, list)
 95        inputs_list = [image_inputs] if is_single else image_inputs
 96
 97        all_features = []
 98
 99        for i in range(0, len(inputs_list), batch_size):
100            batch = inputs_list[i:i + batch_size]
101            batch_tensors = []
102
103            for item in batch:
104                t = self.preprocess_image(item)
105                batch_tensors.append(t)
106
107            tensor_stack = torch.stack(batch_tensors, dim=0).to(self.device)
108
109            with torch.no_grad():
110                feats = self.feature_extractor(tensor_stack)
111                feats = torch.flatten(feats, 1)  # (batch_size, 2048)
112
113                if normalize_embeddings:
114                    feats = F.normalize(feats, p=2, dim=1)
115
116                all_features.append(feats.cpu().numpy())
117
118        final_features = np.vstack(all_features).astype(np.float32)
119        return final_features[0] if is_single else final_features
120
121    def extract_features_safe(
122        self,
123        file_path: Optional[Union[str, Path]]
124    ) -> Tuple[bool, Optional[np.ndarray], str]:
125        """
126        Safely extract features from a file path.
127        Handles missing files and corrupted images without raising exceptions.
128        Returns (success_bool, embedding_or_None, status_msg).
129        """
130        if file_path is None:
131            return False, None, "missing_path"
132
133        path = Path(file_path)
134        if not path.exists() or path.stat().st_size == 0:
135            return False, None, "file_missing_or_empty"
136
137        try:
138            emb = self.extract_features(path, normalize_embeddings=True)
139            return True, emb, "extracted"
140        except (UnidentifiedImageError, OSError) as e:
141            return False, None, f"corrupted_image_{e}"
142        except Exception as e:
143            return False, None, f"extraction_error_{e}"

  1"""
  2Image Downloader and Validator Module for Multimodal News Processing.
  3Handles downloading, caching, PIL validation, and tracking image availability.
  4"""
  5
  6import os
  7import urllib.request
  8import pandas as pd
  9from pathlib import Path
 10from PIL import Image, UnidentifiedImageError
 11from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Any
 12
 13from config.config import BASE_DIR, DATA_PROCESSED_DIR
 14from src.utils.helpers import setup_logger
 15
 16logger = setup_logger("ImageDownloader")
 17
 18IMAGES_DIR = BASE_DIR / "data" / "images"
 19
 20class NewsImageDownloader:
 21    """Manages downloading, validating, and caching news article images."""
 22
 23    def __init__(self, output_dir: Optional[Path] = None, timeout: int = 10):
 24        self.output_dir = output_dir or IMAGES_DIR
 25        self.output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 26        self.timeout = timeout
 27        self.headers = {"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)"}
 28
 29    def fetch_image_for_article(
 30        self,
 31        article_id: str,
 32        image_url: str
 33    ) -> Tuple[bool, Optional[Path], str]:
 34        """
 35        Download and validate image for a given article ID.
 36        Returns: (success_bool, local_path_or_None, status_message)
 37        """
 38        if not image_url or not isinstance(image_url, str) or not image_url.strip():
 39            return False, None, "missing_url"
 40
 41        url = image_url.strip()
 42        local_path = self.output_dir / f"{article_id}.jpg"
 43
 44        # Check local cache first to avoid repeated downloads
 45        if local_path.exists():
 46            is_valid, err = self.validate_image(local_path)
 47            if is_valid:
 48                return True, local_path, "cached"
 49            else:
 50                try:
 51                    local_path.unlink()
 52                except Exception:
 53                    pass
 54
 55        # Format Unsplash URLs with crop/dimension parameters if needed
 56        fetch_url = url
 57        if "unsplash.com" in url and "?" not in url:
 58            fetch_url = f"{url}?auto=format&fit=crop&w=400&q=80"
 59
 60        try:
 61            req = urllib.request.Request(fetch_url, headers=self.headers)
 62            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=self.timeout) as response:
 63                if response.status != 200:
 64                    return False, None, f"http_status_{response.status}"
 65                data = response.read()
 66
 67            with open(local_path, "wb") as f:
 68                f.write(data)
 69
 70            # Validate image with PIL
 71            is_valid, err = self.validate_image(local_path)
 72            if is_valid:
 73                return True, local_path, "downloaded"
 74            else:
 75                if local_path.exists():
 76                    local_path.unlink()
 77                return False, None, f"invalid_image_{err}"
 78
 79        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
 80            return False, None, f"http_error_{e.code}"
 81        except urllib.error.URLError as e:
 82            return False, None, f"network_error_{e.reason}"
 83        except Exception as e:
 84            return False, None, f"error_{str(e)[:50]}"
 85
 86    def validate_image(self, file_path: Path) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
 87        """Verify that file exists and can be decoded by PIL without corruption."""
 88        if not file_path.exists() or file_path.stat().st_size == 0:
 89            return False, "file_empty_or_missing"
 90
 91        try:
 92            with Image.open(file_path) as img:
 93                img.verify()
 94            # Double check re-opening to ensure decoding succeeds
 95            with Image.open(file_path) as img:
 96                img.load()
 97            return True, "valid"
 98        except (UnidentifiedImageError, OSError, Exception) as e:
 99            return False, str(e)
100
101    def download_dataset_images(
102        self,
103        articles_csv: Optional[Path] = None
104    ) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
105        """
106        Iterate over news articles, download missing images, and return status manifest.
107        """
108        csv_path = articles_csv or (DATA_PROCESSED_DIR / "multilingual_news_cleaned.csv")
109        if not csv_path.exists():
110            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Processed news CSV not found at {csv_path}")
111
112        df = pd.read_csv(csv_path, encoding="utf-8")
113        manifest = []
114
115        logger.info(f"Checking images for {len(df)} articles...")
116        for _, row in df.iterrows():
117            aid = str(row["article_id"])
118            url = str(row.get("image_url", ""))
119            lang = str(row.get("language", ""))
120            cat = str(row.get("category", ""))
121
122            success, path, status = self.fetch_image_for_article(aid, url)
123            manifest.append({
124                "article_id": aid,
125                "language": lang,
126                "category": cat,
127                "image_url": url,
128                "is_available": success,
129                "local_path": str(path) if path else None,
130                "status": status
131            })
132
133        downloaded = sum(1 for m in manifest if m["is_available"])
134        failed = len(manifest) - downloaded
135        logger.info(f"Image manifest: {downloaded} available, {failed} unavailable/failed.")
136        return manifest

  1"""
  2Image Feature Pipeline and Multimodal Data Mapping Module.
  3Coordinates image downloading, visual feature extraction via ResNet-50,
  4article ID mapping, and storage in data/embeddings/.
  5"""
  6
  7import sys
  8import json
  9import time
 10import numpy as np
 11import pandas as pd
 12from pathlib import Path
 13from datetime import datetime, timezone
 14from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Any
 15
 16from config.config import (
 17    DATA_PROCESSED_DIR,
 18    DATA_EMBEDDINGS_DIR,
 19    BASE_DIR
 20)
 21from src.vision.image_downloader import NewsImageDownloader, IMAGES_DIR
 22from src.vision.image_encoder import ResNetImageEncoder, RESNET_EMBEDDING_DIM
 23from src.vision.similarity import ImageSimilarityEngine
 24from src.utils.helpers import setup_logger
 25
 26logger = setup_logger("ImageFeaturePipeline")
 27
 28IMAGE_EMBEDDINGS_FILE = DATA_EMBEDDINGS_DIR / "articles_image_embeddings.npz"
 29IMAGE_METADATA_FILE = DATA_EMBEDDINGS_DIR / "articles_image_metadata.json"
 30
 31class ImageFeaturePipeline:
 32    """End-to-end pipeline for image acquisition, feature extraction, and multimodal mapping."""
 33
 34    def __init__(
 35        self,
 36        downloader: Optional[NewsImageDownloader] = None,
 37        encoder: Optional[ResNetImageEncoder] = None
 38    ):
 39        self.downloader = downloader or NewsImageDownloader()
 40        self.encoder = encoder or ResNetImageEncoder()
 41        self.embeddings: Optional[np.ndarray] = None
 42        self.article_ids: List[str] = []
 43        self.has_image_mask: Optional[np.ndarray] = None
 44        self.metadata: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
 45
 46    def run_pipeline(
 47        self,
 48        articles_csv: Optional[Path] = None,
 49        auto_download: bool = True
 50    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 51        """
 52        Execute full image feature extraction and persistence workflow.
 53        """
 54        csv_path = articles_csv or (DATA_PROCESSED_DIR / "multilingual_news_cleaned.csv")
 55        if not csv_path.exists():
 56            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Processed news CSV not found at {csv_path}")
 57
 58        df = pd.read_csv(csv_path, encoding="utf-8")
 59        logger.info(f"Loaded {len(df)} articles for visual processing.")
 60
 61        # Step 1: Check / Download images
 62        if auto_download:
 63            manifest = self.downloader.download_dataset_images(csv_path)
 64            manifest_lookup = {m["article_id"]: m for m in manifest}
 65        else:
 66            manifest_lookup = {}
 67            for _, row in df.iterrows():
 68                aid = str(row["article_id"])
 69                p = IMAGES_DIR / f"{aid}.jpg"
 70                is_valid, status = self.downloader.validate_image(p) if p.exists() else (False, "missing")
 71                manifest_lookup[aid] = {
 72                    "article_id": aid,
 73                    "language": str(row.get("language", "")),
 74                    "category": str(row.get("category", "")),
 75                    "image_url": str(row.get("image_url", "")),
 76                    "is_available": is_valid,
 77                    "local_path": str(p) if is_valid else None,
 78                    "status": status
 79                }
 80
 81        # Step 2: Extract features per article
 82        N = len(df)
 83        D = self.encoder.embedding_dim
 84        embeddings = np.zeros((N, D), dtype=np.float32)
 85        has_image = np.zeros(N, dtype=bool)
 86        article_ids = df["article_id"].tolist()
 87        metadata_dict = {}
 88
 89        start_time = time.time()
 90        success_count = 0
 91        failed_count = 0
 92
 93        logger.info(f"Extracting visual features with ResNet-50 for {N} articles...")
 94        for i, row in df.iterrows():
 95            aid = str(row["article_id"])
 96            m = manifest_lookup.get(aid, {})
 97            is_avail = m.get("is_available", False)
 98            local_path = m.get("local_path")
 99
100            if is_avail and local_path:
101                ok, vec, status_msg = self.encoder.extract_features_safe(local_path)
102                if ok and vec is not None:
103                    embeddings[i] = vec
104                    has_image[i] = True
105                    success_count += 1
106                    status_final = "success"
107                else:
108                    embeddings[i] = np.zeros(D, dtype=np.float32)
109                    has_image[i] = False
110                    failed_count += 1
111                    status_final = f"extraction_failed_{status_msg}"
112            else:
113                embeddings[i] = np.zeros(D, dtype=np.float32)
114                has_image[i] = False
115                failed_count += 1
116                status_final = m.get("status", "missing_image")
117
118            metadata_dict[aid] = {
119                "article_id": aid,
120                "language": str(row["language"]),
121                "category": str(row["category"]),
122                "title": str(row["title"]),
123                "image_url": str(row.get("image_url", "")),
124                "local_path": str(local_path) if is_avail else None,
125                "is_available": bool(has_image[i]),
126                "status": status_final,
127                "model_name": "resnet50",
128                "embedding_dim": D,
129                "generated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC")
130            }
131
132        elapsed_sec = time.time() - start_time
133        logger.info(f"Extracted visual features: {success_count} succeeded, {failed_count} failed in {elapsed_sec:.2f}s.")
134
135        # Step 3: Persist embeddings and metadata
136        self.save_embeddings(embeddings, article_ids, has_image, metadata_dict)
137
138        self.embeddings = embeddings
139        self.article_ids = article_ids
140        self.has_image_mask = has_image
141        self.metadata = metadata_dict
142
143        stats = {
144            "total_articles": N,
145            "images_available": success_count,
146            "images_failed": failed_count,
147            "embedding_dim": D,
148            "model_name": "resnet50",
149            "device": self.encoder.device,
150            "elapsed_seconds": round(elapsed_sec, 2),
151            "npz_path": str(IMAGE_EMBEDDINGS_FILE),
152            "metadata_path": str(IMAGE_METADATA_FILE)
153        }
154
155        return stats
156
157    def save_embeddings(
158        self,
159        embeddings: np.ndarray,
160        article_ids: List[str],
161        has_image: np.ndarray,
162        metadata: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]
163    ) -> None:
164        """Save image embeddings to compressed NPZ and metadata to JSON."""
165        DATA_EMBEDDINGS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
166
167        np.savez_compressed(
168            IMAGE_EMBEDDINGS_FILE,
169            embeddings=embeddings,
170            article_ids=np.array(article_ids, dtype=object),
171            has_image=has_image
172        )
173        logger.info(f"Saved image embeddings to {IMAGE_EMBEDDINGS_FILE}")
174
175        with open(IMAGE_METADATA_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
176            json.dump(metadata, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
177        logger.info(f"Saved image metadata to {IMAGE_METADATA_FILE}")
178
179    def load_embeddings(self) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, List[str], np.ndarray, Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]]:
180        """Load persisted image embeddings and metadata from disk."""
181        if not IMAGE_EMBEDDINGS_FILE.exists() or not IMAGE_METADATA_FILE.exists():
182            raise FileNotFoundError("Image embeddings or metadata file not found.")
183
184        data = np.load(IMAGE_EMBEDDINGS_FILE, allow_pickle=True)
185        embeddings = data["embeddings"]
186        article_ids = list(data["article_ids"])
187        has_image = data["has_image"]
188
189        with open(IMAGE_METADATA_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
190            metadata = json.load(f)
191
192        self.embeddings = embeddings
193        self.article_ids = article_ids
194        self.has_image_mask = has_image
195        self.metadata = metadata
196
197        return embeddings, article_ids, has_image, metadata
198
199    def get_article_image_embedding(self, article_id: str) -> Optional[np.ndarray]:
200        """Retrieve 2048-d visual feature vector if article image is available."""
201        if self.embeddings is None:
202            self.load_embeddings()
203
204        try:
205            idx = self.article_ids.index(article_id)
206            if self.has_image_mask[idx]:
207                return self.embeddings[idx]
208            return None
209        except ValueError:
210            return None
211
212    def find_similar_images(
213        self,
214        article_id: str,
215        top_k: int = 5
216    ) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
217        """
218        Find top-K visually closest articles that have valid image embeddings.
219        """
220        if self.embeddings is None:
221            self.load_embeddings()
222
223        query_vec = self.get_article_image_embedding(article_id)
224        if query_vec is None:
225            return []
226
227        # Only search within candidates that actually have valid images
228        valid_indices = [
229            i for i, aid in enumerate(self.article_ids)
230            if self.has_image_mask[i] and aid != article_id
231        ]
232
233        if not valid_indices:
234            return []
235
236        candidate_embeddings = self.embeddings[valid_indices]
237        candidate_ids = [self.article_ids[i] for i in valid_indices]
238
239        top_results = ImageSimilarityEngine.find_top_k(
240            query_embedding=query_vec,
241            candidate_embeddings=candidate_embeddings,
242            candidate_ids=candidate_ids,
243            top_k=top_k
244        )
245
246        results = []
247        for aid, score in top_results:
248            meta = self.metadata.get(aid, {})
249            results.append({
250                "article_id": aid,
251                "title": meta.get("title", ""),
252                "language": meta.get("language", ""),
253                "category": meta.get("category", ""),
254                "similarity_score": round(score, 4)
255            })
256
257        return results

87        print(f"     A: [{m1['language'].upper()}] ({m1['category']}) {m1['title'][:45]}")

Module Purpose: Visual cosine similarity matrix computation and nearest-neighbor visual retrieval. 
 1"""
 2Visual Embedding Similarity Module.
 3Computes cosine similarity, pairwise visual similarity matrices, and nearest-neighbor visual search.
 4"""
 5
 6import numpy as np
 7from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Union
 8
 9class ImageSimilarityEngine:
10    """Computes cosine similarity and visual rankings on dense image representations."""
11
12    @staticmethod
13    def compute_similarity(vec_a: np.ndarray, vec_b: np.ndarray) -> float:
14        """Calculate cosine similarity between two 1D image feature vectors."""
15        norm_a = np.linalg.norm(vec_a)
16        norm_b = np.linalg.norm(vec_b)
17        if norm_a == 0 or norm_b == 0:
18            return 0.0
19        return float(np.dot(vec_a, vec_b) / (norm_a * norm_b))
20
21    @staticmethod
22    def compute_similarity_matrix(
23        embeddings_a: np.ndarray,
24        embeddings_b: Optional[np.ndarray] = None
25    ) -> np.ndarray:
26        """
27        Compute pairwise cosine similarity matrix between visual embeddings.
28        Normalizes rows to unit L2 norm.
29        """
30        if embeddings_b is None:
31            embeddings_b = embeddings_a
32
33        norm_a = np.linalg.norm(embeddings_a, axis=1, keepdims=True)
34        norm_b = np.linalg.norm(embeddings_b, axis=1, keepdims=True)
35
36        norm_a = np.where(norm_a == 0, 1e-9, norm_a)
37        norm_b = np.where(norm_b == 0, 1e-9, norm_b)
38
39        a_norm = embeddings_a / norm_a
40        b_norm = embeddings_b / norm_b
41
42        return np.dot(a_norm, b_norm.T)
43
44    @staticmethod
45    def find_top_k(
46        query_embedding: np.ndarray,
47        candidate_embeddings: np.ndarray,
48        candidate_ids: List[str],
49        top_k: int = 5,
50        exclude_id: Optional[str] = None
51    ) -> List[Tuple[str, float]]:
52        """
53        Find top-K visually closest candidates to query_embedding.
54        Returns list of (candidate_id, similarity_score).
55        """
56        sims = ImageSimilarityEngine.compute_similarity_matrix(
57            query_embedding.reshape(1, -1),
58            candidate_embeddings
59        )[0]
60
61        ranked_indices = np.argsort(sims)[::-1]
62
63        results = []
64        for idx in ranked_indices:
65            cid = candidate_ids[idx]
66            if exclude_id and cid == exclude_id:
67                continue
68            results.append((cid, float(sims[idx])))
69            if len(results) >= top_k:
70                break
71
72        return results
